# dsh-opendesign-provider
English | 简体中文
**Install (one command, no build step):**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH afterwards. `lib/` is committed, so pnpm needs no build script to install from git.
**Supported DSH engines:** `0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `latest`) and `0.2.1-rc.3` (npm `next`). `engines.dsh`

is
authoritative — DSH's admission preflight disables this bundle on any other engine version.

Unofficial DeepSeek Harness LLM provider for **Open
Design**. It registers the `open-design` provide

r route under the `llm-opendesign` plugin row, so one profile
can use Open Design models next to eve
ry other provider without route or namespace conflicts.

This project is a community integration. It is **not affiliated with or endorsed by Open Design /
Po
werformer**, and your use of the Open Design service is governed by Open Design's own terms.
**Status: P0 and the P1 quota surface are in.** Chat Completions transport, live model catalog, cred

ential
chain, settings page, the opt-in sidebar quota card with its dashboard and the `/opendesign`

command are
delivered. P2's model-analytics page was removed after it shipped: it was a history-stat

istics view nobody
asked for, and it made the settings sidebar longer for no daily use. Cost and cap

ability remain catalog tier
words on the model card, never an amount.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`lib/` is committed, so a git install needs no build step. `npm pack` still rebuilds it through the
`prepack` script, which keeps the tarball in sync with `src/`.
Restart the app after installing. Then check:

- **Settings → Open Design** shows the page (connection, models and context, display, advanced).
- *
*Settings → Models** shows the Open Design card with the key state and the catalog source.
The bundle ships `lib/`, its `cordis.patch.yml` row and the `dsh.client` declaration. It only insert

s its own
`llm-opendesign` row and never rewrites another provider's route, so it coexists with an a

lready installed
Command Code plugin.
> The package has **no plugin icon** yet (the `icon` metadata field is intentionally absent). A bran

d asset
> must come from a design source; nothing is faked here.
## Identifiers
| Item | Value |

| Package | `@mars-sea/dsh-opendesign-provider` |
| Provider route | `open-design` |
| Display name

| `Open Design` |
| Settings namespace / plugin row | `llm-opendesign` |
| Default credential refere

nce | `OPEN_DESIGN_API_KEY` |
| Default API base | `https://amr-link.open-design.ai/v1` |
| Model ca

talog cache | `~/.opendesign/models-cache.json` |
| CLI login state (read-only) | `~/.amr/config.jso

n` |
| Remote namespace | `opendesign` (`models`, `usage`; `report` reserved) |
| Telemetry switches
| `DSH_OPENDESIGN_TIMING`, `DSH_OPENDESIGN_TRACE` |
## Credentials
Resolution is one ordered pass; the first hit wins:

1. **Explicit key** — `config.apiKey` in the composition (secret role, redacted everywhere).
2. **Cr

edential reference** — `config.apiKeyEnv`, default `OPEN_DESIGN_API_KEY`, resolved through the
crede

ntials seam (the Models page writes here) or the launching environment.
3. **CLI login state** — `~/

.amr/config.json` → `profiles.prod.runtimeKey`, written by `vela login`. Used only
when neither laye
r above has a value.
The gateway address follows the key's source: an explicit `config.apiBase` always wins; a key from t

he CLI
login state uses that state's server-issued `linkUrl` with `/v1` appended when the URL is a b

are origin (the
live `linkUrl` is a host, e.g. `https://amr-link.open-design.ai`); everything else u
ses the default gateway.
The plugin **never writes** `~/.amr/config.json` and never prints a key. Settings and diagnostics on

ly show the
reference name, whether it resolves and where the key came from. `profiles.prod.controlK

ey` is read by the
quota feature (read-only, never written back) and is not used for inference.
No browser login, no device-code flow, no account pool: Open Design is a single-key model.
## Models
The picker reads `GET {apiBase}/models` per key. When the gateway is unreachable, unauthorized or re

turns a
malformed body, the built-in 12-model snapshot is used and the catalog source is reported as

`static`; the
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- **No invented USD amounts.** Cost is a tier label; the quota panel shows credit windows and the wa

llet
balance the control plane reports, never a derived invoice.
- **No browser/device login, no acc

ount pool, no ZDR, no web search, no plan filtering.** They have no Open
Design equivalent.
- **Sing

le credential.** The last resolved key serves the profile; no rotation.
- **Thinking visibility depe

nds on the transport.** On the Chat face `gpt-6-luna` and `claude-haiku-5.5`
emit no reasoning. `con

fig.protocol: auto` (the default) routes `claude-haiku-5.5` over the optional
Messages transport, wh

ere its thinking is readable once an explicit thinking budget is requested; the
gateway only returns

`redacted_thinking` (encrypted) for `gpt-6-luna` there, so readable reasoning for it
exists only on

the Responses API, which this plugin does not implement.
- **File/audio/video input is refused** ev

en when the gateway advertises the modality.
- **No plugin icon** yet.
- **No TUI settings page**; t

he settings page is the web UI. (P2 if needed.)
- **Chat Completions is the default transport**; the

optional Anthropic Messages transport
(`config.protocol: chat | messages | auto`) covers the thinki

ng-hidden models and falls back to Chat once
if the gateway does not serve it. The Responses API is

out of scope (ADR-0001).
- `temperature`, `stop`, `logprobs` and `store` are not sent. `developer` m

essages are downgraded to `system`
because glm rejects the role.
- **429 / `Retry-After` is implemen

ted but not observed live** (the probes never triggered a limit), and there
are no `x-ratelimit-*` h

eaders to lean on.
- **Settings-page interaction is verified by tests and by a real-profile install*

*; the browser pass is the
maintainer's restart step after installing the packed tarball (the bundle
layer loads at boot).
